blind.description: A cylindrical wooden barrel or vat resting on an integrated four-legged low wooden stand. The barrel is constructed from vertical wooden staves bound by three dark iron hoops with visible rivets. The top has a segmented wooden rim enclosing a planked lid with a central rectangular hatch plate, four corner bolts, and a small handle. The stand consists of four vertical square wooden feet braced with horizontal beams. Surfaces are solid, clean, and continuous with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating unattached geometry, and nothing is melted or fused. The four feet of the stand sit flat on the floor. Materials are natural brown wood grain and dark metal; there are no unpainted or plain black patches, no flames or glow, and no text or labels visible.
blind.from_above: A circular wooden structure featuring a segmented outer rim surrounding a flat planked wooden lid, centered with a raised rectangular wooden hatch secured by four corner bolts and a central handle.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3 to 3.5 ft tall (roughly 50% to 60% of the 5 ft 9 in figure's height) and about 3 to 3.5 ft wide (significantly wider than the slender figure).
